title: ActiveSAM: Fast and Accurate Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Frozen SAM 3
abstract: arXiv:2606.16996v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM 3) provides a strong frozen backbone for concept-prompted segmentation, but applying it directly to open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) is inefficient: full-resolution decoding is typically run over the entire dataset vocabulary, whereas each image contains only a small active subset of classes. We introduce ActiveSAM, a training-free inference framework that turns SAM 3 into an active-vocabulary segmenter. ActiveSAM first canonicalizes and expands class prompts, then uses evidence-proportional grounding to estimate an image-conditioned active set from a low-resolution presence preview. Only retained prompts receive full-resolution mask prediction, using bucketed prompt multiplexing with the frozen SAM 3 decoder. translated_title: ActiveSAM：基于冻结SAM 3的快速精确开放词汇语义分割
translated_abstract: 分割任意物体模型3（SAM 3）为概念提示分割提供了强大的冻结骨干网络，但将其直接应用于开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）是低效的：通常需要对整个数据集词汇表进行全分辨率解码，而每张图像实际只包含一小部分活跃类别子集。我们提出ActiveSAM，这是一个无需训练的推理框架，可将SAM 3转变为活跃词汇分割器。ActiveSAM首先对类别提示进行规范化并扩展，然后利用证据比例定位从低分辨率存在性预览中估计图像条件下的活跃类别集合。只有被保留的提示才会借助冻结的SAM 3解码器进行全分辨率掩码预测，并采用分桶提示复用技术。预览阶段仅使用类别存在性证据，从而跳过不必要的分割头计算。为解决概念响应重叠的问题，独占概念解码机制通过比较（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出无需训练的ActiveSAM框架，通过低分辨率类别存在性预览筛选图像相关的活跃类别，仅对保留的提示进行全分辨率掩码预测，将冻结的SAM 3高效转化为快速且准确的开放词汇语义分割器。
en_tdlr: ActiveSAM is a training-free inference framework that turns frozen SAM 3 into an active-vocabulary segmenter by using a low-resolution presence preview to select a small image-conditioned class set and running full-resolution mask decoding only on retained prompts, achieving fast and accurate open-vocabulary semantic segmentation.
